dsh-sampling-sliders is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Model sampling sliders (temperature / maxTokens) in the composer: override every model request for all providers via the agent/request hook, with hot/persist modes.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-bbc62313df29b27635ff.html
